overview_description.description:
We are Indonesia's first quick commerce company that promises #CrazyFast deliveries of groceries and household essentials in 15 minutes 24x7. Simply select from over 2,000 products, make payment, and receive it instantly - It's that EaZY

Our mission is simple: Bring convenience and make 15-minute delivery the new normal
